name: Rétalap (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow light blue vertical stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Rétalap: a yellow and green shield with a cross, a plough and a bird, inscribed RÉTALAP.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
